objects.description: [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has downloaded additional binaries from the C2 server such as sqlx[1].dll, a sqlite3 binary for data harvesting and exfiltration.(Citation: Cyfirma_Vidar_June2024) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has also ownloaded get.zip, an archive containing several DLL libraries that extracted data from applications and browsers.(Citation: Logpoint_StealerMalwareFamilies_2024)
